title: Pause billing
description: Pause a monthly plan for 1 to 6 whole months, for example between seasons. The pause starts when the period you paid for ends. While it runs the organization is read-only: everything stays readable and exportable, and no data is deleted.
preview: Pauses on {startsOn}. Billing and changes resume on {resumesOn}.
scheduled: Billing pauses on {startsOn} and resumes on {resumesOn}.
runningOpen: Paused in Stripe, with no resume date.
resumeStarted: Resuming starts a new billing period today and charges it now.
notMonthly: Only a monthly plan paid through Stripe can pause. An annual plan is paid for the year.
ownerOnly: Only the Owner can pause or resume billing.
paused: Billing is paused. It starts on {startsOn}.
banner: This organization is paused until {date}. Everything stays readable and exportable; changes resume when it does.
bannerOpen: This organization is paused. Everything stays readable and exportable; changes resume when the Owner resumes billing.
bannerScheduled: Billing pauses on {startsOn}. The organization will be read-only until {resumesOn}.

refusals.pause_not_paid: Only a plan paid through Stripe can pause.
refusals.pause_trial: A trial cannot pause. Pause once the plan is paid.
refusals.pause_past_due: A payment is overdue, so billing cannot pause. Update the payment method first.
refusals.pause_annual: An annual plan is paid for the year and cannot pause.
refusals.pause_open: This organization already has a pause. Resume it or cancel it first.
refusals.pause_months_range: A pause lasts 1 to 6 whole months.
refusals.pause_period_unknown: Stripe has not reported the end of the paid period yet. Try again in a minute.
refusals.pause_not_active: The Stripe subscription is not active, so it cannot pause.
refusals.pause_none: This organization has no pause to resume.
refusals.pause_needs_payment_method: Add a payment method in the billing portal, then resume.
refusals.org_read_only: A read-only organization cannot pause. Settle what made it read-only first.
refusals.billing_through_partner: Your partner bills this organization. Ask the partner about a pause.
refusals.billing_not_open: Billing is not open on this XOS yet.
refusals.step_up_required: Confirm it is you with your second factor, then try again.
refusals.other: Billing could not pause or resume. Try again in a moment.
